test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 05
subject: general
question:
Find the **wrong** term in the following series:

1CV, 5FU, 9IT, 15LS, 17OR
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6500bccef3874e27b8cdd222f7b2819e86fc260f658a57f5ef13e64219a9b1d4.png] 

According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6dbef7f1643b14a2eeb4ef51559aca03308f2698a59d74d45171366bdcded85.png] 

In place of ‘15LS’ it should be ‘13LS’.

Hence, ‘15LS’ is the wrong term in the series.
